name: Modern Trends in Drug Development
description: Introduction to drug development, administration routes, pharmacokinetics and drug metabolism; fundamentals of drug targets; fundamentals of drug-biomolecule interactions; biophysical and biochemical techniques in drug development; enzyme inhibitors as drugs; receptor modulators as drugs; targeted protein degradation (TPD) in drug development: proteasomal and lysosomal protein degradation pathways and artificial hijacking by small molecules; drugs modulating immune response; protein-protein interactions (PPIs) and therapeutic relevance: clinical significance, PPI inhibitors, peptidomimetics; drugs against protein aggregation; proteomics in drug development; prodrugs: rationale, functional group approach and activation strategies, antibody-directed enzyme prodrug therapy, antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs); tissue-specific drug delivery.
